# Dead-API guard allowlist (deadapi_test.go).
#
# One entry per line: "<rule> <pkg>.<Name>  # reason". The reason is required.
# An entry is for API that is deliberately meant for application code and so
# has no reader inside this repository. Anything that generated code or a
# generator should read does NOT belong here — delete it or wire it up.
# The guard fails on an entry that is no longer needed.

d runtime.ValidateRegistries  # application startup check; generated code never calls it
